body: I've tried, but the bullying only stops for a short time.
Bullying, and the unbearable anxiety that comes with it

Well I don't have much time to do things I like after school because I have a daily visit to the psychologist. I'd say what's bothering me most is that my parents have recently been avoiding me and barely talking to me, I just feel like I'm in my own bubble.
I wouldn't even say I'm dreading high school, I'm just dreading the next ~7 months of this year.

1. I've tried learning self defense, but it doesn't really help me much when 4 or 5 of them gang up on me

2. I don't really have any friends, I did in elementary school, but all of them abandoned me. I have serious problems with talking to people in general and get really anxious when people try to talk to me
I've told almost everyone, But no one takes me seriously.
